snippet.title: Hookeye - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Hookeye, a psychological fishing horror game developed by Mallorian and FloralNoise. Players will embody an obsessed fisher with nothing but his fishing lines, some beer, and time to burn on the water. Trade whatever's necessary for the next big catch in Hookeye, coming soon to PC (Steam).
